name: Buy Temple of Ikov supplies

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.

name: Light the candle before descending into the Temple of Ikov

evidence.note: Use a tinderbox on the unlit candle to prepare a light source for the cellar.

name: Cut the web and take Boots of lightness

evidence.note: Cut the web with a knife and pick up the boots with a light source. The pickup can occur before starting the quest.

name: Ask Lucien about the Staff of Armadyl

evidence.note: Speak to Lucien at the Flying Horse Inn.

name: Cross the bridge and retrieve the lever

evidence.note: Equip Boots of lightness and keep carried weight below zero. Leave heavier equipment at a bank if necessary.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Cross the bridge with negative weight and take the lever.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Fit and pull the lever

evidence.note: Install the lever in the bracket and pull it.

name: Search the chests for ice arrows

evidence.note: Use the south gate and search changing chests until the reserve is ready. Return to the gate.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Collect at least 30 ice arrows before leaving the room.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Search the northern lever for traps

evidence.note: Search the lever to disable the trap before pulling it.

name: Pull the searched lever

evidence.note: Pull the lever to open the northern passage.

name: Defeat Lesarkus with ice arrows

evidence.note: Use a yew shortbow and ice arrows. The route reserves the whole bundle and excludes variable combat XP.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat the Fire Warrior with ice arrows. Refill the reserve if the fight takes longer.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Give Winelda 20 limpwurt roots

evidence.note: Hand over 20 unnoted roots and cross to the far side of the lava.

name: Pick up the shiny key

evidence.note: Take the shiny key for the McGrubor's Wood shortcut.

name: Side with the Guardians of Armadyl

evidence.note: Remove Lucien's pendant, offer to help and take the Armadyl pendant.

name: Steal the Staff of Armadyl for Lucien

evidence.note: Take the staff from its chamber and defeat the Guardian that opposes you.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Leave the chamber with the Staff of Armadyl.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Defeat Lucien with the Armadyl pendant

evidence.note: Wear the Armadyl pendant and defeat Lucien at his Varrock house.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Deliver the Staff of Armadyl to Lucien

evidence.note: Give Lucien the staff at his Varrock house.

name: Record the chosen Temple of Ikov ending

evidence.note: Record the quest reward after the chosen final interaction.

name: Report the Staff of Armadyl to Historian Minas

evidence.note: Report the events of Temple of Ikov to earn five kudos.

name: Buy Kolodion combat supplies

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.

name: Accept Kolodion's duel

evidence.note: Speak to Kolodion at base level 60 Magic and accept his challenge. He transports you to the duel.

name: Defeat all five forms of Kolodion

evidence.note: Use Fire Blast with a staff of air and a suitable supply of healing or prayer restoration. The plan debits a 120-cast reserve. After the fifth form, use the nearby lever to return to the Mage Arena bank.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Defeat human, ogre, spider, ghost and demon Kolodion. If the reserve runs out, restock before continuing.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Claim the Saradomin cape

evidence.note: Pray at the corresponding statue and pick up the cape.

name: Claim the free Saradomin staff

evidence.note: Talk to the Chamber Guardian with the chosen cape.

name: Claim the Guthix cape

evidence.note: Pray at the corresponding statue and pick up the cape.

name: Claim the free Guthix staff

evidence.note: Talk to the Chamber Guardian with the chosen cape.

name: Claim the Zamorak cape

evidence.note: Pray at the corresponding statue and pick up the cape.

name: Claim the free Zamorak staff

evidence.note: Talk to the Chamber Guardian with the chosen cape.

name: Take the museum's specimen tools and protective gear

evidence.note: Take the available tools and wear the boots and gloves to clean finds.

name: Clean specimens until you find the pottery

evidence.note: Take uncleaned finds and use the specimen table while wearing the protective gear. This is an estimated share of the time for cleaning all five exhibit finds.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Find one pottery before moving to its case.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Put the pottery in display case 22

evidence.note: Identify the find with an archaeologist if needed. Deposit it into display case 22 for ten kudos.

name: Find a clean necklace while cleaning specimens

evidence.note: Clean finds until the untradeable clean necklace appears. The timing is an estimate for the variable drop.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Allow additional time and prepare for another attempt.

name: Show the clean necklace to a museum archaeologist

evidence.note: Hand in the clean necklace to learn the ruby necklace enchantment.

name: Buy supplies to enchant a Digsite pendant

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.

name: Cast level-3 enchant on a ruby necklace

evidence.note: Cast the standard spell after learning it from the archaeologist. A new pendant has five charges.

name: Attune the Digsite pendant at the strange machine

evidence.note: Use the charged pendant on the strange machine after Bone Voyage. Attunement unlocks the island destination.

name: Record the Digsite pendant diary task

evidence.note: The diary task registers on arrival when the pendant is used to teleport to the Digsite.

name: Buy Bone Voyage potion supplies

evidence.note: Purchase an estimated supply bundle at the Grand Exchange.
